Done. Summary of what I found:

**The trace:** Board deck (DOC-0207) shows US GL 6200 Q1 = **USD 11,769.00**. The GL today shows **USD 14,569.00** (Jan 4,289.70 + Feb 4,139.80 + Mar 6,139.50).

**The explanation — a single item, ties to the cent:** The USD 2,800.00 gap is **JE-00304**, the Tessellate BI Q1 seat true-up (14 extra seats, Jan–Mar), dated 2026-03-31 and supported by DOC-0206. It was *created* at 2026-04-02 10:14, but the deck was pulled from the GL at 2026-04-01 09:00 — so it's purely a data-pull timing difference, not an error in the deck or the ledger.

**Ruled out:** Two identical USD 149.90 Zoom charges both dated 2026-03-08 looked like a double-post, but the bank shows two separate settlements that day (BT-US-0062 and BT-US-0063), each with its own receipt. Both are legitimate.

**The correct Q1 figure is USD 15,819.00**, not 14,569.00 — because Q1 isn't finished. The March Figtree prepaid amortization of USD 1,250.00 hasn't been booked: GL 1210 still sits at 12,500.00 (only two months amortized), and the "Amortize prepaid software" checklist item is open. Per DOC-0067 that entry is due at March close.

So the board figure is understated by USD 4,050.00 (2,800 true-up + 1,250 amortization). Per your instruction I made no postings and left the checklist item open; I raised no exceptions since every element of the variance is fully supported.
